facts.fact: The Data Protection Act 2017 is the law the Data Protection Office enforces, per the Commissioner.
Drudeisha Madhub is Data Protection Commissioner at the Data Protection Office.
The office reports 19,071 controllers and 1,013 processors registered, 345 breach notifications, 19 published guides and about 250 data protection officers trained, undated.

note: No dated ruling against a named organisation.
